鼓膜在轻轻动，耳蜗里的细胞在传消息。让我们把一小段声音的旅程慢下来，看看哪一步发: The eardrum moves, and cells inside the cochlea send a message. Slow down a short sound journey to discover where the kind of movement changes.
跟着振动，走进耳朵: Follow a vibration into the ear
靠近中耳和内耳: Closer to the middle and inner ear
声波经耳道到鼓膜，听小骨传动耳蜗，听神经向脑传递信号。: Sound reaches the eardrum through the canal; the ossicles transmit vibration to the cochlea, and the auditory nerve carries a signal toward the brain.
鼓膜把空气中的振动接过来；右边的紫色路线表示神经信号。上方弯曲的半规管主要参与平: The eardrum receives vibrations from air. Purple on the right represents a neural signal. The curved semicircular canals above mainly contribute to balance.
展开的耳蜗显示基底膜上不同响应位置，放大图显示纤毛束、内毛细胞和神经连接。: An uncoiled cochlea shows response positions along the basilar membrane; the close view shows a hair bundle, inner hair cell and neural connection.
金色淡影标出较强响应的位置。基底膜实际卷在耳蜗里；这里展开比较，波形幅度被夸大。: The pale gold envelope marks the stronger response region. The basilar membrane is coiled in the real cochlea; here it is uncoiled, with exaggerated displacement.
先停在“耳蜗回应”，再比较金色淡影的位置。音高与响度不是一回事。: Pause at “Cochlear response” and compare the gold envelope. Pitch and loudness are different properties.
只调整画中位移，不发声音，也不是分贝或听力测试。: This changes drawn displacement only. It produces no sound and is not a decibel scale or hearing test.
耳朵不用塞进任何东西，也不用开大声音来做实验。只看屏幕，就能比较这段旅程。: Nothing needs to go into your ears, and no loud sound is needed. Explore this journey on screen.
观察窗口和讲解方式可以随时切换，当前进度会保留。: Change the view or reading mode at any time; your current progress stays in place.
鼓膜带动锤骨、砧骨和镫骨。镫骨在卵圆窗处把振动传给内耳液体，帮助空气中的声音进入: The eardrum moves the malleus, incus and stapes. At the oval window, the stapes transfers vibration into inner-ear fluid, helping sound pass from air into a fluid environment.
耳蜗不是一根空管子: The cochlea is more than a tube
里面有液体、膜和感觉细胞。基底端较偏向回应高音，顶端较偏向回应低音。真实声音往往: It contains fluid, membranes and sensory cells. The base responds best to higher frequencies, and the apex to lower ones. Real sounds usually contain many frequencies.
毛细胞顶端的纤毛束非常微小。它弯曲时会改变细胞的电信号，细胞再影响相连的神经；空: The hair bundle on a hair cell is microscopic. Bending changes the cell’s electrical response and then activity in a connected nerve. Air does not blow through the nerve into the brain.
深入看：机械传动、位置编码和细胞换能: Explore further: mechanics, place coding and transduction
中耳通过鼓膜与镫骨底板的面积差及听小骨杠杆作用，提高向内耳传递能量的效率；它不凭: The eardrum-to-stapes area ratio and ossicular leverage improve energy transfer into the inner ear; they do not create sound energy. Basilar-membrane mechanics vary along its length, so the traveling-wave peak depends on frequency. The gold region is qualitative: a frequency does not activate just one point.
纤毛束偏转影响机械敏感离子通道，使毛细胞产生受体电位；内毛细胞通过递质释放影响听: Hair-bundle deflection affects mechanically sensitive ion channels and the hair cell’s receptor potential. Inner hair cells release transmitter that affects auditory-nerve firing. Outer hair cells also contribute active amplification and frequency selectivity, a feedback process omitted here. The cell view leaves out the tectorial membrane, precise ion gradients, synaptic detail and brainstem relays; it cannot measure hearing, speed or real displacement.
自主绘制的概念解剖图，比例、颜色和振动幅度为观察而调整。镜头移动不表示组织真的被: An original conceptual anatomy drawing. Scale, color and displacement are adjusted for observation. Camera movement does not mean tissue is being pulled apart; the demonstration follows part of air-conduction hearing.
位置表示相对高低音，不标真实频率: Relative pitch positions, not measured frequencies
膜上不同位置，回应不同音高: Different membrane positions favor different pitches
一枚内毛细胞的局部原理: One inner hair cell: a close view
尺度再次放大；略去盖膜和其他细胞: Further enlarged; tectorial membrane and other cells omitted
空气把振动带到鼓膜: Air carries vibration to the eardrum
空气在声波中来回振动；不是一串空气小球一路飞到脑。先找耳道尽头那层薄膜。: Air oscillates in a sound wave; a string of air balls does not fly to the brain. Find the thin membrane at the end of the canal.
鼓膜轻轻动，三个相连的小骨头也传动，镫骨把振动交给耳蜗里的液体。: The eardrum moves, and three connected bones transmit the motion. The stapes passes vibration into cochlear fluid.
耳蜗里的膜和细胞回应: The cochlear membrane and cells respond
展开耳蜗，比较较高音和较低音的响应位置；再看感觉细胞顶端的纤毛束怎样偏转。: Uncoil the cochlea and compare higher- and lower-pitch response positions. Then inspect the deflection of the hair bundle on a sensory cell.
神经把消息传向脑: Nerves carry a message toward the brain
感觉细胞将机械变化转为电反应，再影响听神经。脑还会经过许多步骤加工这些消息。: Sensory cells convert mechanical changes into electrical responses and influence the auditory nerve. Many further stages in the brain process these messages.
这是一个内毛细胞的原理放大。液体运动使纤毛束偏转，影响离子通道与神经连接；不是一: This is an enlarged inner-hair-cell mechanism. Fluid movement deflects the bundle, affecting ion channels and the neural connection. It is not body hair, and sound waves do not enter the nerve directly.
